owners.label: Thunderous Determination
owners.description: The DMG multiplier of Resonance Skill Thunder Uprising is increased by 40%, and its reduction efficiency of enemy Vibration Strength is enhanced.

owners.label: Reserved Confidence
owners.description: The ranges of the Resonance Skills Thunder Field and Thunder Uprising are greatly expanded. When switched off the field during combat, if "Readiness" is not full, Yuanwu will automatically leave 1 Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge in place.

owners.label: Lightning Manipulation
owners.description: Yuanwu unleashes thunderbolts in an area centered around the skill target, greatly reducing the Vibration Strength of enemies upon impact.

owners.label: Steaming Cup of Justice
owners.description: When Yuanwu is in Forte Circuit's Lightning Infused state, his Basic Attack Speed is increased by 20%, and his Heavy Attack Speed is increased by 20%.

owners.label: Fierce Heart, Serene Mind
owners.description: Intro Skill Thunder Bombardment additionally recovers 15 Resonance Energy for Yuanwu.

owners.label: Upholder of Integrity
owners.description: When the Coordinated Attacks of Resonance Skill's Thunder Wedge hits a target, the damage is additionally increased by 20% of Yuanwu's DEF.

owners.label: Retributive Knuckles
owners.description: When casting Resonance Liberation Blazing Might, the on-field character will gain a Shield equal to 200% of Yuanwu's DEF for 10s.

owners.label: Neighborhood Protector
owners.description: When Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge is on the field, Yuanwu's Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus is increased by 50%.

owners.label: Defender of All Realms
owners.description: All team members nearby within the range of Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge will gain a 32% DEF increase, lasting 3s.
